decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly casting spells for free using Cascade mechanics, while also incorporating powerful creatures and disruption spells to maintain control of the board. By cascading into cards like Crashing Footfalls and Shardless Agent, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with an army of creatures. Cards like Violent Outburst and Lórien Revealed help trigger Cascade consistently, while spells like Force of Negation and Subtlety provide disruption and protection. The goal is to apply pressure early on and maintain tempo throughout the game to outpace opponents and secure victory.

The deck focuses on using creatures with various abilities to create a toolbox of options to either combo off or disrupt opponents. By utilizing cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide, Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and Chord of Calling, the deck can search for specific creatures for different situations. The deck also has sacrifice outlets like Young Wolf and Zulaport Cutthroat to gain value from sacrificing creatures. The main goal is to control the board and combo off with key pieces like Agatha's Soul Cauldron or Sheoldred, the Apocalypse for a win condition.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures that can be used as a toolbox to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, the deck can tutor for specific creatures and manipulate board states to gain an advantage. The combo potential of Spike Feeder and Archmage beats is also present, providing a win condition that can catch opponents off guard. The versatility and synergy of the creatures in the deck allows for adaptability in different matchups and scenarios.

Utilizing the combination of UrzaTron lands and powerful artifacts, this deck focuses on controlling the game by ramping quickly into large threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also features ways to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Relic of Progenitus and Oblivion Stone, while also having access to Boseiju, Who Endures for protection against counter spells. With a solid mana base and a variety of win conditions, this deck aims to outlast and overpower the opponent in a game of attrition.

This deck focuses on using creatures as a toolbox to assemble different combos and synergies. It includes cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron, Grist, the Hunger Tide, and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to generate value and control the board. The combination of tutors like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution with creatures like Wall of Roots and Orcish Bowmasters allows for flexibility and adaptability to various game states. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent through incremental advantage and efficient creature interactions.

The deck focuses on using Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to generate value by sacrificing creatures and putting -1/-1 counters on the opponent's creatures. It also utilizes a toolbox of creatures like Strangleroot Geist and Orcish Bowmasters to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck can access its toolbox efficiently using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. Grist, the Hunger Tide and Agatha's Soul Cauldron provide additional ways to generate tokens and value. Overall, the deck aims to assemble powerful creature combinations and overwhelm the opponent.

The deck revolves around using Wrenn and Six alongside Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. It also utilizes cards like Leyline Binding and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the opponent's board while setting up the combo. The inclusion of cards like Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt provide additional interaction and removal. The deck aims to create unexpected and explosive plays through its unique combo pieces and synergies, catching opponents off guard and closing out games quickly.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Hardened Scales enchantment to boost the +1/+1 counters placed on creatures. By maximizing the counters through cards like Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp and Walking Ballista, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a swarm of powerful creatures. The inclusion of cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Urza's Saga helps to further develop the board presence and increase the overall synergy of the deck. With a combination of efficient creatures and powerful enchantments, this Aggro-Hardened Scales deck aims to end the game quickly and decisively.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of equipping Colossus Hammer onto a creature and dealing massive damage. The deck includes cards like Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid to help cheat equipment into play, along with key pieces like Stoneforge Mystic to search for needed cards. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a huge, fast attacker equipped with powerful equipment like Colossus Hammer to end the game in just a few turns. Multiple ways to protect your combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy ensure a strong performance in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on using land ramp and Amulet of Vigor to accelerate mana production and play Primeval Titan as quickly as possible. The goal is to assemble the Titan and land combo to generate a large amount of mana and tutor for utility lands like The Mycosynth Gardens and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal damage to the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and The One Ring to further enhance mana production and allow for explosive turns.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to create a toolbox of options for different situations. By combining cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron, Grist, the Hunger Tide, and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, the deck can generate value through sacrificing and recurring creatures while disrupting the opponent's board state. The key strategy is to assemble the right combination of creatures to execute powerful combos and outvalue the opponent, ultimately leading to victory through card advantage and board control.

This deck focuses on disruption and tempo, using cards like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch to control the opponent's resources while deploying aggressive threats like Grief and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Undying Evil and Darkblast to keep pressure on the opponent and ensure that threats are difficult to deal with. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also enabling powerful plays. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying a consistent and aggressive offense.

This deck focuses on casting creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Misty Rainforest for free using cascade spells like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst. With the support of cards like Dead / Gone and Force of Negation, this aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and efficient board presence. The inclusion of control elements like Mystical Dispute and Subtlety helps to protect your key threats while disrupting your opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to gain tempo and advantage through cascading into powerful creatures and spells.

The main concept of this deck is to abuse the Cascade mechanic to quickly and consistently cast Living End, a powerful sorcery that can potentially wipe out the opponent's board and bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard. The deck includes a variety of creatures with Cycling abilities to help filter through the deck and find combo pieces, as well as disruption in the form of Force of Negation. By cascading into Living End, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a win through powerful creatures and efficient plays.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Cascade mechanic with cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into Living End, a powerful sorcery that returns all creature cards from both players' graveyards to the battlefield. By discarding creatures like Street Wraith and Grief to enable cascade triggers, the deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard and then cast Living End to overwhelm the opponent with a board full of creatures while disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the key pieces needed to ramp up mana and tutor for Primeval Titan, in order to create a powerful board presence, utilizing lands like Amulet of Vigor, Arboreal Grazer, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to accelerate the process. The combo relies on utilizing the land tutors and land synergy to generate overwhelming advantage and quickly close out the game with Primeval Titan and lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck aims to establish a dominant position on the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful combinations.
